name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Training & Enablement | Team Onboarding, Coaching, Workshops & Knowledge Base
summary: Team lead and enablement builder who gets new people productive and keeps tenured people sharp. At Wix I led onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists over two years, ran weekly training, workshops for new initiatives, and 1:1 coaching, helped hire and train new team members, and helped build sales training for tenured account executives, while personally launching 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets. I write plain-language documentation people actually use, including 18 published articles.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Train business owners and staff on every system before go-live, and document each workflow so teams can run it without me.
Wrote and published 18 plain-language articles explaining technical topics (CRM setup, automation, SEO) for non-technical readers.
Built rubric-based grading criteria to evaluate output quality against a defined standard, and use the results to improve the process.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Led onboarding and training for 15-20 reseller partners, retaining all but one (~94%).
Built automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction across the partner network.
Analyzed partner utilization data to spot adoption gaps early, and fed findings back into training and onboarding.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Took on team lead for the sales team, and built processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led multiple onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists over 2 years, piloting different team structures as a new vertical scaled from proof of concept to a profitable business line.
Ran weekly team training sessions, workshops for new initiatives, and individual 1:1 coaching for onboarding specialists.
Contributed to hiring, onboarding, and training new hires, and helped develop sales training for tenured account executives.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Held workshops for client teams showing how each part of a complex CRM and project-management platform would work for them.
